article.story: Dartmouth Big Green (2-1) at Albany (NY) Great Danes (2-1) Albany, New York; Wednesday, 1 p.m. EST LINE: Big Green -1.5; over/under is 143.5 BOTTOM LINE: Dartmouth faces Albany (NY) after Cameron McNamee scored 20 points in Dartmouth's 78-71 overtime loss to the Central Connecticut State Blue Devils. Albany (NY) went 6-5 at home a season ago while going 11-21 overall. The Great Danes averaged 72.0 points per game while allowing opponents to score 72.9 last season. Dartmouth finished 6-8 on the road and 11-16 overall a season ago. The Big Green averaged 13.5 assists per game on 25.0 made field goals last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
